newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -FTSE may fall back to around 4,770.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -FTSE may fall back to around 4,770.

text.p: The FTSE 100 index is likely to fall back to around 4,770 on Tuesday as the London stock market tries to consolidate recent gains, technical analysts said.
The difficulty the market had in budging far from 4,800 on Monday indicates a possible resting place for the FTSE over the short-term, they added.
And yet because of the steep rise of last week -- when the FTSE raced up 172 points -- it would be normal for the market to experience a little downward pressure.
By 0727 GMT, in pre-market trade, the FTSE was indicated down 6.6 at 4,804.1.

Its refusal to go down too far on Monday as well as its comparatively narrow trading range -- the FTSE merely shunted in a 44-point range on Monday as against 175 points on the day after the budget -- suggests decreasing market volatility, analysts said.
And despite some mild profit-taking, investors still seem prepared to buy on dips -- but they are becoming selective.
As a result, the market may settle in a tight range over the short-term although the tendency will be to lose some of its upward momentum over the next few days, they added.
